name: Pangolin
description: Connect through a dedicated Pangolin Newt site and public resource.

providers.label: Pangolin
providers.description: Connect through a dedicated Pangolin Newt site and public resource.
providers.security: Install Newt and create a dedicated site and HTTPS resource in your Pangolin dashboard, targeting the loopback bridge. Allow the Recursive protocol paths through your resource policy. Recursive starts only this dedicated Newt process with SSH disabled. Host access still requires Recursive authentication.

schema.label: Pangolin server
schema.description: HTTPS origin of your Pangolin dashboard.

schema.label: HTTPS endpoint
schema.description: Full origin, such as https://remote.example.com, with no path.

schema.label: Dedicated Newt site ID
schema.description: Create a new site for this provider; do not reuse a running site.

schema.label: Loopback bridge port
schema.description: Set your Pangolin resource target to http://127.0.0.1:18445, or the port chosen here.
